## Goal

Establish a verified baseline of `main` and a frozen backup before any rebuild work.

## Context

Audit done 2026-11-27, results in `docs/STATUS.md`. Branches `archive/pre-rebuild` and `rebuild/v2` were created locally from `main` @ `466c542` and need to be pushed by someone with push rights.

## Scope

- Push `archive/pre-rebuild` and `rebuild/v2` (the one-time bootstrap script `bootstrap-github.ps1`, delivered outside the repo, does it).
- Protect `main` and `archive/pre-rebuild` in GitHub settings (no direct push, no force push, no deletion).
- Set `rebuild/v2` to require a PR and green CI.

## Out of scope

- Any code change.
- Deleting old branches.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both branches exist on origin and point at `466c542`.
- [ ] Branch protection active on `main`, `archive/pre-rebuild`, `rebuild/v2`.
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` reflects the audit.

## Required tests

- `git ls-remote origin archive/pre-rebuild rebuild/v2` shows `466c542`.

## Dependencies

- none

## Priority

P0 · Phase A

## Agent

Cowork (PM) + owner
